match.description: Rules that automatically select this profile based on git remote or filesystem path.

agent.description: Default coding agent to launch for this profile.

icon.description: Optional icon displayed for this profile in banners and statuslines.

secret.description: Name of an encrypted secret store under ~/.config/aide/secrets/ (or absolute path) decrypted for template expressions.

env.description: Environment variables injected into the agent process (supports {{ .secrets.<key> }}, {{ .project_root }}, {{ .runtime_dir }}).

config_dir_name.description: Suffix for per-profile agent native config directories (e.g. ~/.claude-<name>).

config_dir.description: Explicit base directory override for agent native configuration.

config_dirs.description: Per-harness explicit native config directory overrides keyed by canonical harness name.

credentials.description: Named provider credential bindings backed by age/sops secret stores or keyless routes.

default_credentials.description: Credential binding names injected by default when no explicit selection is made.

gateways.description: Custom or preset LLM gateways available in this profile.

gateway_choice.description: Default gateway per harness: a gateway name, 'none', or omitted for unset.

yolo.description: Override auto-approve / yolo mode for this profile.

capabilities.description: Capabilities granted to agents launched under this profile.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers enabled in this profile: either a list of server names or an override block ({ only, exclude, extra }).

MatchRule.description: Matches a workspace by git remote glob or filesystem path glob.

remote.description: Glob pattern matched against the normalized git remote URL (e.g. github.com/org/*).

path.description: Glob pattern matched against the workspace directory path (supports ~ and **).

remote_name.description: Git remote name to inspect (defaults to 'origin').

CredentialBinding.description: Named provider credential route backed by an age/sops secret store or keyless provider.

store.description: Secret store name under ~/.config/aide/secrets/ or absolute path.

key.description: Key name inside the encrypted secret store.

env.description: Environment variable names to inject the secret into.

agents.description: Restrict this credential binding to the listed agents.

capabilities.description: Additional capabilities automatically enabled when this binding is selected.

CredentialRoute.description: Per-agent environment variable injection and companion settings for a credential binding.

env.description: Environment variable names receiving the secret value.

set.description: Non-secret companion environment variables set alongside the credential.

GatewayConfig.description: LLM gateway configuration (preset or custom endpoint).

api.description: Wire protocol spoken by the gateway.

no_auth.description: Use this gateway without an API key or secret store.

model.description: Default model ID to select when using this gateway.

region.description: Cloud region (used by provider-switch presets such as bedrock or vertex).

project.description: Cloud project ID (used by provider-switch presets such as vertex).

refresh_ttl.description: Go duration controlling how long cached model discovery results stay fresh (e.g. '24h').

store.description: Secret store name containing the gateway token.

key.description: Key name inside the secret store for the gateway bearer/API token.

NetworkPolicy.description: Network policy: a mode string ('outbound', 'none', 'unrestricted') or structured port policy.

allow_subprocess.description: Allow spawning subprocesses inside the sandbox.

clean_env.description: Scrub inherited environment variables before launch.

unguard.description: Guards to disable for this policy.

SandboxRef.description: Sandbox setting: false to disable, a named sandbox profile string, { profile }, { inline }, or an inline SandboxPolicy.

profile.description: Name of a sandbox policy defined in sandbox.yaml (or 'default' / 'none').

command.description: Executable command for a stdio MCP server.

url.description: HTTP/SSE endpoint URL for a remote MCP server.

args.description: Command-line arguments for a stdio MCP server.

env.description: Environment variables for the MCP server.

MCPServerOverride.description: Per-profile delta over top-level mcp_servers declared in provisioning.yaml.

only.description: Replace inherited MCP servers with only these names.

exclude.description: Remove these MCP server names from the inherited set.

extra.description: Additional MCP servers defined only for this profile.

PluginEntry.description: Plugin entry: list of plugin names (marketplace), string install reference (URL-direct), or null (declare-only marketplace).

PluginOverride.description: Per-profile delta over top-level plugins declared in provisioning.yaml.

only.description: Replace inherited plugins with only these repo or repo/plugin paths.

exclude.description: Remove these repo or repo/plugin paths from the inherited set.

extra.description: Additional plugin entries for this profile.

command.description: Shell command executed when the hook triggers.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (0 uses the agent driver default).

HooksOverride.description: Per-profile additions and suppressions over top-level hooks declared in provisioning.yaml.

exclude.description: Hook event names to suppress completely.

exclude_hooks.description: Map of event name to list of named hooks to exclude.

extra.description: Additional hooks keyed by normalized event name.
